dn26:7.3: In whatever place the wheel-treasure stood still, there the king came to stay together with his army.
dn26:7.4: And any opposing rulers of the western quarter came to the wheel-turning monarch and said,
dn26:7.5: ‘Come, Great King! Welcome, Great King! We are yours, Great King, instruct us.’
dn26:7.7: ‘Do not kill living creatures. Do not steal. Do not commit sexual misconduct. Do not lie. Do not drink liquor. Maintain the current level of taxation.’
dn26:7.8: And so the opposing rulers of the western quarter became his vassals.
dn26:8.7: ‘My man, when you see that the heavenly wheel-treasure has receded back from its place, please tell me.’
dn26:8.8: ‘Yes, Your Majesty,’ that man replied to the wheel-turning monarch.
dn26:8.9: After many years, many hundred years, many thousand years had passed, that man saw that the heavenly wheel-treasure had receded back from its place.
dn26:8.10: So he went to the wheel-turning monarch and said,
dn26:8.11: ‘Please Your Majesty, you should know that your heavenly wheel-treasure has receded back from its place.’
dn26:8.12: So the wheel-turning monarch summoned the crown prince and said,
dn26:8.13: ‘Dear prince, my heavenly wheel-treasure has receded back from its place. I’ve heard that
dn26:8.14: when this happens to a wheel-turning monarch, he does not have long to live.
dn26:8.15: I have enjoyed human pleasures. Now it is time for me to seek heavenly pleasures. Come, dear prince, rule this land surrounded by ocean!
dn26:8.16: I shall shave off my hair and beard, dress in ocher robes, and go forth from the lay life to homelessness.’
dn26:8.17: And so, after carefully instructing the crown prince in kingship, the wheel-turning monarch shaved off his hair and beard, dressed in ocher robes, and went forth from the lay life to homelessness.
dn26:19.7: In the same way, the best kind of food will be finger millet for humans who live for ten years.
dn26:19.12: In the same way, among humans who live for ten years, anyone who disrespects mother and father, ascetics and brahmins, and fails to honor the elders in the family will be venerated and praised.
dn26:20.8: In the same way, among humans who live for ten years, those beings will be full of hostility toward each other, with acute ill will, malevolence, and thoughts of murder.
dn26:20.9: Even a mother will feel like this for her child, and the child for its mother,
dn26:20.10: father for child, child for father,
dn26:20.11: brother for sister, and sister for brother.
dn26:28.32: The Wheel-Turning Monarch is finished, the third.
